aspect: It removes capacity for work as reliably as an amputation
description: Concentration, tolerance of unpredictability, interpersonal capacity and sleep are all requirements of employment, and war-related illness takes all four at once.
energy_note: Unemployable, and told it is an attitude problem.

aspect: Disability systems are built for visible injuries
description: Assessment forms ask about stairs, lifting and distance walked. A person unable to leave the house because of hypervigilance scores well on all of them and is found fit.
money_note: Benefits denied on an inapplicable assessment.
energy_note: Passing a test that measures the wrong thing.

aspect: Stigma is heavier where the war came from
description: In many of the societies producing these injuries, psychiatric illness is a family reputational matter. Treatment is avoided, concealed, or sought in another city under another name.
money_note: Private care chosen to avoid a record.
energy_note: Paying extra so no one finds out.

aspect: Medication access is a sanctions problem too
description: Antipsychotics, mood stabilisers and modern antidepressants are imported or made from imported ingredients. In shortage, substitution and interruption are the norm, and both destabilise a stabilised patient.
energy_note: Stable for two years, then the supply changes.

aspect: SCENARIO - the brother who is 'not well'
description: He has lived in the back room since 2009. The family says he is not well. He has never been assessed, never been treated, never claimed anything, and appears in no statistic about the war he was in.
energy_note: A whole life, unrecorded, in a back room.
